timeline.labelEn: Founding of New Amsterdam, the Dutch settlement that became New York City
timeline.labelDe: Gründung von Nieuw Amsterdam, der niederländischen Siedlung, aus der New York City wurde

questions.notes: Multiple choice removed; the card's answer is New York, which at about 40°42′ N lies far south of Paris (about 48.9° N) and London (about 51.5° N). Accept answers around 40–41° N.

questions.en: Which physicist used his Nobel Prize money to pay off his ex-wife after their divorce?

timeline.labelEn: Albert Einstein, physicist and Nobel laureate (1879–1955)

questions.notes: Multiple choice removed. Einstein promised Mileva Marić the prize money to obtain the divorce (granted 14 February 1919); after the 1921 prize he paid it into a trust account in Zurich, from which she received the interest.
